# Onform

> > Onform is a mobile video coaching platform for iOS devices that enables coaches to analyze athlete performance, provide feedback, and integrate with tools like Pocket Radar, Full Swing KIT Launch Monitor, and Garmin Approach R10.

Onform provides comprehensive video analysis and coaching tools for sports professionals and athletes on iPhone, iPad, and iPod touch. The platform offers 3D visualization, integration with performance monitoring devices, and collaborative coaching features previously found in Coach's Eye.

## Key Topics

- Onform coaching platform
- Video analysis
- Mobile coaching app
- iOS (iPhone, iPad, iPod touch)
- Pocket Radar integration
- Full Swing KIT Launch Monitor
- Garmin Approach R10
- 3D visualization
- Coach's Eye
- Performance feedback
- Athlete training
- Sports coaching technology
- Video capture and playback
- Remote coaching
